anchor_rule: cell holding the footprint centroid (floor((x - ox) / size), floor((y - oy) / size))
merge_rule: anchor cell + every cell whose closed square intersects the 15 m reach buffer (region_score REACH_M); union-find transitive closure; all scored cells kept

oldenburg.training_design: families (J_s, A_s, C_s) resampled together, 3 draws with replacement; ADAF, CONT fixed

verden.training_design: selection-aware: 5 JOINT-1 confirmation seeds drawn with replacement, S* = highest region-macro DEV primary among those drawn (FRESH-1 rule); ADAF, CONT fixed
